BiblicalUsage: Cheresh is a Levite named once, among the Levites who dwelt in Jerusalem after the return from exile. He stands in the list of the men who served at the house of God, a single name kept among the singers and gatekeepers of the restored city.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a name kept in the service of God's house is honour enough, even when nothing else is recorded of the man.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
